newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury moves up two bill announcement times.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury moves up two bill announcement times.

text.p: The Treasury Department said Friday it will move up the announcement times on Christmas Eve and on New Year's Eve for its regularly scheduled weekly bill sales.

The announcements on Dec 24 and on Dec 31 will be made at 1200 EST (1700 GMT) rather than the regularly scheduled time of 1430 EST (1930 GMT), a Treasury official said. Financial markets generally close early before each of the holidays.
Treasury announces each Tuesday the details of its planned three- and six-month bill sales that are made on the following Monday.
